errorCodes.meaning: The proven caller holds no administrative role at this community.

The request did not arrive over a delivery that can carry a stream — over HTTPS, a request without `Accept: text/event-stream`, or a binding that defines no streamed response. The console falls back to polling.
The caller already holds as many open streams as the community allows. Close one (another tab or device), or poll.

Ext.description: Vendor-namespaced extension object per SPEC.md §4.5.1. Each immediate key MUST be a reverse-DNS namespace; structure under each namespace is opaque to the framework.
Ext.title: Ext

Response.description: The subscription as granted, sent as the first document on the stream. Failures use trust-task-error and open no stream.

heartbeatSeconds.description: The longest the community lets the stream go without sending anything. Over HTTPS the heartbeat is an SSE comment. A console that receives nothing for twice this interval MUST treat the stream as dead.

resumeToken.description: The stream position as of this response, so that a console that disconnects before its first event still has a token to resume from.

resumed.description: `true` when the community recognised the request's `resumeToken` and will send a hint for every effective topic that changed after it. `false` when no `resumeToken` was given or it could not be honoured; the console MUST then re-fetch every effective topic, because it may have missed changes.

topics.description: The effective topics: those requested that the caller may read. The community sends events for these and no others. A requested topic missing here is one the caller may not read, and the console MUST NOT present it as live.

Response.title: VTC Admin Events — Subscribe — response payload

ResumeToken.description: Opaque, community-minted position in one caller's event stream. A console MUST NOT parse, construct or order it; it only hands the latest one back as `since` when it re-subscribes. A community binds it to the caller it was minted for and treats a token minted for anyone else as unknown.
ResumeToken.title: ResumeToken

Topic.description: One kind of change a console can be told about. A closed set: a topic not listed here is a new MINOR version of this component, not an `ext` member, because each topic is bound to the read that authorizes it.
Topic.title: Topic

schema.description: Open an administrator console's live channel of hint-only events. The success response is the first document on a stream that then carries vtc/admin/events/event/0.5 documents; over HTTPS that stream is the streamed response of bindings/https/0.3 §2.1. The outer document members (id, type, issuer, recipient, issuedAt, expiresAt, proof) are owned by the framework — SPEC §6.3.

resumeToken.description: The last `resumeToken` the console received on an earlier stream, to resume from (named `since` before 0.5). A token the community does not recognise, has expired, or minted for another caller is not an error: the stream starts fresh and the response says `resumed: false`.

topics.description: The topics the console renders. The community narrows this to the topics the caller may read and reports the result as the response's `topics`.
